label: Face length
notes: Centerline length proxy from the upper face to the chin.

label: Forehead width
notes: Average of three horizontal forehead spans.

label: Cheekbone width
notes: Average of three horizontal cheekbone spans and the ratio denominator.

label: Jaw width
notes: Average of three horizontal jaw spans.

label: Face ratio
notes: Face length divided by cheekbone width.

label: Forehead ratio
notes: Forehead width divided by cheekbone width.

label: Jaw ratio
notes: Jaw width divided by cheekbone width.

label: Width variance
notes: Coefficient of variation across the three horizontal widths.

label: Jaw angle
notes: Mean jaw-corner angle used as a rounded-versus-angular signal.
